notes.title: Songs being removed when terminate contract bug fix
notes.notes: * Songs from other bands are not removed when you terminate contract with bands.

notes.title: Right Slot Bug Fix
notes.notes: When the player purchased the right studio slot first, there was a bug where the player was unable to select the Next Band button. This bug could be mitigated by buying the left band slot. But now we updated the build so the player can buy any slot first.
